name: Dual Vertex Positioning via Least Squares
aliases: Dual Vertex Localization via Quadratic Error Minimization
definition: A method to compute the position of a dual vertex within a cell by minimizing the squared distance to all edge intersection points on the isosurface boundary of that cell.
summary: Dual Vertex Positioning via Least Squares computes a dual vertex by minimizing the quadratic error function of distances to edge intersections, ensuring accuracy through least squares optimization.
